q: What makes a problem a good fit for DP?
options: Overlapping subproblems with an optimal/combinable substructure
why: The same smaller problems come up repeatedly and their answers combine into the bigger answer.

q: Plain recursive Fibonacci / Climbing Stairs runs in…
why: Each call branches into two, and the same values are recomputed over and over.

q: With memoization, Climbing Stairs for n steps takes…
why: Each of the n states is computed once in O(1).

q: What does this return for n = 5?
code:
a, b = 1, 1
for _ in range(n - 1):
    a, b = b, a + b
return b

q: Min Cost Climbing Stairs: which definition makes the recurrence simplest?
options: dp[i] = total cost of the array
dp[i] = cheapest cost to stand on step i
why: Then dp[i] = min(dp[i − 1] + cost[i − 1], dp[i − 2] + cost[i − 2]).
